chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from 'Abd al-Samad ibn Bashir, from Fudayl ibn Sukkarah, who said:

I said to Abu Ja'far (عليه السلام): “May I be sacrificed for you, if you see fit to teach me: did Allah, majestic is His Face, know before He created the creation that He is One? For your followers have differed. Some of them said: He had known before He created anything from His creation. And some of them said: the meaning of ‘He knows’ is ‘He does’; so today He knows that there is no other than Him before the bringing about of things.”
So they said: “If we affirm that He never ceased being knowing that there is no other than Him, then we have affirmed along with Him something other than Him in His eternality.”
So if you see fit, O my master, teach me that which I will not go beyond to anything else.” Then he (عليه السلام) wrote: “Allah has never ceased being Knowing. Blessed and Exalted is His mention.”

key_terms.أَزَلِيَّتِهِ: His eternality; the state of having no beginning
key_terms.الْخَلْقَ: the creation; all created beings and things
key_terms.عَالِمًا: Knowing; describing Allah as eternally possessing knowledge
key_terms.مَوَالِيكَ: your followers/allies; those attached in wilayah to the Imam
key_terms.يَعْلَمُ: to know; here, referring to Allah’s attribute of knowledge

ai.seo_question: Did Allah know before creating creation that He is One?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a theological question about Allah’s eternal knowledge before the creation of all things. Imam Abu Ja'far (عليه السلام) gives a concise creedal answer, affirming that Allah has always been Knowing, thereby establishing divine knowledge as an eternal attribute.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad, from Abdul Samad Bin Bashir, from Fuzayl Bin sukkara who said,

‘I said to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! If you<sup>asws</sup> see fit, if you<sup>asws</sup> could teach me, ‘Did Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Majestic is His<sup>azwj</sup> Face, Know before He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the creation that He<sup>azwj</sup> is One, for the ones in your<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah are differing. So, some of them say, He<sup>azwj</sup> was Knowing before He<sup>azwj</sup> Creating a thing from His<sup>azwj</sup> creation’, and some of them say, ‘But rather, the meaning of knowing is His<sup>azwj</sup> Doing, thus today He<sup>azwj</sup> Knows that He<sup>azwj</sup> (is One), there being no other, before He Did (Create) the things. So they are saying, ‘It is proved for us that He<sup>azwj</sup> did not cease to be a Knower that He<sup>azwj</sup> (is One), there is none other, and so it is proved for us that there was other than Him<sup>azwj</sup> (i.e., Knowledge), along with Him<sup>azwj</sup> in His<sup>azwj</sup> eternality’.
So if you<sup>asws</sup> see fit, O my Chief<sup>asws</sup>, if you<sup>asws</sup> could teach me what I do not leave it to something else’.
So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> did not cease to be a Knower. Blessed and High is His<sup>azwj</sup> Mention’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from ’Abd al-Samad ibn Bashir from Fudayl ibn Sukkarah who has said the following.

“I asked abu Ja‘far (a.s.), ‘May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, if you would consider it proper please enlighten me about whether Allah, Majestic is Whose face, had knowledge of His Oneness before He brought the creation into existence? Your followers differ on this issue. There are those who believe that Allah did have knowledge of His Oneness before He created anything. Others say His knowledge is His action. Thus, now Allah has come to know that before He created things there had been nothing besides He Himself.
They say that if we believe in the eternal knowledge of Allah of His Oneness, we have established another thing eternal along with Him.

If you would consider it proper please enlighten me in this issue so I may not waver here and there.” He wrote, “Allah, the Blessed and Exalted has always had the Knowledge of all things.” (See Hadith No. 294 – 53)
